question: Gold futures (GCZ26) daily settlement price on August 11, 2026

model.prompt_context: This market resolves based on the official CME Group daily settlement price for the December 2026 COMEX Gold futures contract (GCZ26) for the August 11, 2026 trading session, published by CME Group (cmegroup.com). Each price band is inclusive of its lower bound and exclusive of its upper bound: a settlement price of exactly $4,400.00 resolves to the "$4,400.00 – $4,429.99" outcome.
